QuestInfo.name: What is Left to Us
QuestInfo.0: You used Gaon's keycard and logged into the laboratory system. However, most of the data has deleted. Check in with Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: You scraped enough data to learn that the traitor elders were researching the #bSpecters#k. What you don't know yet is why.
QuestInfo.2: Hinya and Duhan want to reunite the scattered Anima of the world. Meanwhile, it occurs to you that the Shangri-La researchers might have some insight as to what the traitor elders were after on Carcion.

0.msg: Hinya and Duhan are looking for you, #h0#. Did you need anything else?
